name: BioPathNet (emyyue/BioPathNet b051a900, gene-function checkpoint model_epoch_12)
adds_beyond_module: Relation-typed, partly directed (unsigned) path explanations over Pathway Commons 12 with per-edge data source and PubMed ids; WWOX gene-pathway ranking is specific (median Jaccard 0.05 vs 10 degree-matched controls) and puts Hippo at rank 2 (neighbour vote: 13). Nothing for drug-target relations: no drug-repurposing checkpoint is released
licence_read: Code MIT (verified); checkpoint ships in the MIT repo, no model terms; data no licence of their own, derived from Pathway Commons 12 with restricted sources (HumanCyc SRI licence, PhosphoSitePlus CC BY-NC-SA, DrugBank, KEGG, CTD, NetPath) and KEGG labels; paper CC BY 4.0
integration_cost_h: 2-3 to reproduce (pinned torch 2.0.1 venv, 5 min for 11 queries at 1.5 GB); explanations need >11 GB RAM per query on CPU (killed); a drug model needs GPU training on PrimeKG (not attempted)
risk: Explanation step OOM on the 15 GB host; torchdrug 0.2.1 does not compile against torch >= 2.4; restricted upstream data; MSigDB motif predictions stored as controls-expression-of; one checked WWOX step cites a paper that does not name WWOX; Pathway Commons 12 includes KEGG 2011 interactions (label leakage risk, unmeasured)
verdict: WATCH - explanations not obtained on CPU within the pre-registered 8 GB limit
reopen_condition: Reopen if any of: (1) explanation for one query runs in <= 8 GB RAM on CPU (e.g. an upstream subgraph-restricted explain mode, or a host with >= 32 GB RAM or an operator-authorised GPU), then run the pre-registered step (c) unchanged; (2) a PrimeKG drug-repurposing checkpoint is released with a split covering DEE/WOREE; (3) a typed graph with signed drug-target edges replaces the Pathway Commons BRG
